prioritization.p0: Evidence or safety-sensitive ingredients and formulations; prioritize authoritative sources, interaction gates and high-risk populations
prioritization.p1: Commonly requested compounds with indication-specific clinical trials
prioritization.p2: Formulations and overlapping products; evaluate parent ingredient equivalence
prioritization.p3: Limited evidence products; informational only pending adequate data

release_policy: No automatic dosing without indication-specific source and validated safety rules
Library text is not a clinical deep record
No generic effectiveness inference from botanical class or supplement category
All 100 entries must remain searchable even if recommendation is blocked
